description: Suggest campaign ideas from your company profile. Free. Answers at once; the ideas show in campaign_ideas_list once suggesting is false, replacing every idea not launched yet. With segment it adds ideas for that audience instead.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

offer.description: With segment: what to offer that audience, e.g. "Tax planning and tax return preparation". At most 1000 characters.

segment.description: An audience of your own, e.g. "Dental clinics in Ohio opening a second location". At most 1000 characters.

name: campaign_ideas_suggest
title: Suggest campaign ideas from your company profile
